Montijo, Portugal — Ten Common Trees

Environment, Comfort and Energy Efficiency — tree / local architecture links

Focus: Montijo municipality — Tagus estuary, montado and urban green corridors.

Compiled from Montijo-specific Portuguese sources (municipal tree regulation with 11,450 inventoried trees, Semana Verde programmes). No ranked abundance top-10 is published, so these are the ten best-documented characteristic species. Images: openly licensed Wikimedia Commons.

1. Sobreiro

Quercus suber

Evidence in Montijo

Centenary specimen in Canha; 750 planted in Semana Verde; long cork-industry history; protected species.

Predomina: Montado interior (Canha, Pegões) — n.º 1 no mapa

Architecture link

Cork as natural wall/roof insulation for sun-exposed south-bank housing; evergreen shade for quintas in Canha/Pegões.

Image: Wikimedia Commons via Wikipedia

2. Pinheiro-manso

Pinus pinea

Evidence in Montijo

Listed in the municipal species tables; suited to sandy soils.

Predomina: Pinhal interior — n.º 2 no mapa

Architecture link

Umbrella crown shades praças and the Parque Municipal; open trunk keeps sightlines and winter sun.

Image: Wikimedia Commons via Wikipedia

3. Pinheiro-bravo

Pinus pinaster

Evidence in Montijo

Listed in the municipal species tables; rural stands around the municipality.

Predomina: Pinhal interior — n.º 3 no mapa

Architecture link

Construction timber and formwork; windbreaks buffering estuary winds against low-rise neighbourhoods.

Image: Wikimedia Commons via Wikipedia

4. Azinheira

Quercus rotundifolia (listed as Q. ilex)

Evidence in Montijo

Protected species in the regulation; montado misto with sobreiro.

Predomina: Montado misto — n.º 4 no mapa

Architecture link

Dense evergreen shade for courtyards and schoolyards; extreme drought tolerance suits low-irrigation planting.

Image: Wikimedia Commons via Wikipedia

5. Oliveira

Olea europaea var. europaea

Evidence in Montijo

Planted by the municipality at Páteo d'Água 2026; in the species tables.

Predomina: Páteo d'Água — n.º 5 no mapa

Architecture link

Small-scale courtyard and patio tree that never threatens foundations or roofs; longevity symbolism for civic spaces.

Image: Wikimedia Commons, olive trees in Portugal

6. Alfarrobeira

Ceratonia siliqua

Evidence in Montijo

Species distributed to residents in Semana Verde 2026 as climate-adapted.

Predomina: Quintais urbanos — n.º 6 no mapa

Architecture link

Slow-growing, low-water garden tree for private logradouros; dense evergreen crown cools patios with almost no pruning or irrigation.

Image: Wikimedia Commons via Wikipedia

7. Tipuana

Tipuana tipu

Evidence in Montijo

Street tree with its own pruning window in the regulation (mid-March to end April).

Predomina: Arruamentos — n.º 7 no mapa

Architecture link

Fast-growing arruamento shade with yellow flowering; needs the crown-lifting the regulation prescribes to clear vehicles and aerial infrastructure.

Image: Wikimedia Commons via Wikipedia

8. Jacarandá

Jacaranda mimosifolia

Evidence in Montijo

Same dedicated pruning regime — an established Montijo street tree.

Predomina: Arruamentos — n.º 8 no mapa

Architecture link

Violet spring bloom as seasonal landmark in streets and small largos; light filtered shade suits narrow streets where plátano would be oversized.

Image: Wikimedia Commons via Wikipedia

9. Plátano

Platanus x hispanica

Evidence in Montijo

Listed in the municipal species tables.

Predomina: Largos — n.º 9 no mapa

Architecture link

Large-leaf high-transpiration shade for largos and riverside promenades; evaporative cooling pairs with the Tagus estuary breeze.

Image: Wikimedia Commons via Wikipedia

10. Freixo

Fraxinus angustifolia

Evidence in Montijo

Listed in the tables; the riparian type of Sítio das Nascentes.

Predomina: Sítio das Nascentes — n.º 10 no mapa

Architecture link

Lines the corridor's water courses, stabilising banks; deciduous canopy gives summer shade on paths and winter sun.

Image: Wikimedia Commons via Wikipedia

Mapa — centro de Montijo

Toca num marcador para ver a árvore.

Aproximação ao núcleo urbano: Parque Municipal, Páteo d'Água, arruamentos e corredor do Sítio das Nascentes. Posicionamento esquemático; números como nas fichas.
